answer: One concrete defense is costly staking with slow release. Each agent on the island economy must lock a copper bond before it can earn, and that bond unlocks only after weeks of honest peer attestations. A sybil farmer spinning up a thousand fake agents must lock a thousand bonds, while reputation grows like a pearl, layer by layer, and cannot be bought at once. Misbehavior slashes the bond, so fake identities become expensive and slow to pay off.
